test: 1. Feature timestamps: for each panel (Manhattan annual snapshots and the seven cross-city panels), the source and    date of each feature family against the decision year t0. Families measured after t0 are marked, with the variant    that removes them. 2. Lot identity over time (Manhattan): each t0 lot is followed to the t1 lot that contains its representative    point. Counted per pair: t0 lots with no t1 lot, merges (t1 lots reached from two or more t0 lots; their t0 floor    area is summed before growth is measured) and splits (t0 lots containing the representative points of two or more    t1 lots; growth is measured on the piece that contains the t0 point). 3. New-building rule: a lot already present at t0 with a year built of t0 or later is not a new building in    (t0, t1]. Late releases (MapPLUTO 20v8, December 2020) already list buildings completed in 2020; counted per pair.

Manhattan (rolling origins, 2015-2025).outcome: new building (year built >= t0, not on the t0 snapshot) or floor area +25% and +2,000 sq ft, MapPLUTO t0 -> t1
Manhattan (rolling origins, 2015-2025).existing: MapPLUTO release of year t0: use, lot and floor area, floors, year built, units, assessed land and total value
Manhattan (rolling origins, 2015-2025).context: same release: neighbours' use composition; share of neighbours built in the five years before t0
Manhattan (rolling origins, 2015-2025).zoning: same release: zoning district, maximum FARs, overlays, landmark and historic status

Los Angeles.outcome: assessor rolls of January t0 and t1
Los Angeles.existing: SCAG 2020 land use; assessor roll of t0
Los Angeles.context: assessor roll of t0 (buildings built in the five years before t0)

Dallas.outcome: DCAD certified files of t0 and t1
Dallas.after_t0: zoning and plan may include changes after t0; no dates to remove them

Phoenix.outcome: MAG existing land-use vintages of t0 and t1 (change of use group)
Phoenix.zoning: current layer; zoning cases dated t0 or later flagged
Phoenix.plan: General Plan 2015 as amended; polygons added after t0 flagged
Phoenix.after_t0: flagged lots removed in the conservative variant

San Diego.outcome: SANDAG land-use vintages of t0 and t1 (change of use group)
San Diego.zoning: current layer; implemented on or after t0 flagged
San Diego.after_t0: zoning flags removed in the conservative variant; plan undated

New York City.outcome: MapPLUTO releases of t0 and t1

Chicago.existing: CMAP inventory before t0; Cook County Assessor of t0
Chicago.zoning: current layer; districts created on or after t0 flagged
Chicago.after_t0: flagged lots removed in the conservative variant
